Definition: of Hebrew origin (H4429); Malchus, an Israelite:--Malchus.
BiblicalUsage: Malchus was the high priest's servant whose right ear Peter cut off in the garden, named once, in John 18:10, where Simon Peter drew his sword and smote the servant, and the servant's name was Malchus. He was a servant of the high priest, and his name is given only in John's account.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Malchus is remembered for the worst night of his life and the best: the ear Peter cut off is the ear Jesus healed.
